recent_articles.title: Himachal urban poll results reflect public confidence in Congress; party united with no groupism, says CM Sukhu - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Sukhvinder Singh Sukhu**, Chief Minister of **Himachal Pradesh**, attributed the Congress-backed candidates' victory in recent urban local body elections to public approval of the party's governance. He highlighted the sustained popularity despite anti-incumbency pressures and emphasized a unified effort among party workers.  He also criticized the BJP for its perceived lack of support for Himachal Pradesh, particularly regarding issues like the Revenue Deficit Grant and natural disasters. Sukhu asserted that the Congress has fulfilled its promises and exceeded expectations in delivering on commitments such as welfare schemes and reforms in education and healthcare.

recent_articles.title: BJP, Congress attack SP over party spokesperson’s remark on Brahmins; FIR registered - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Rajkumar Bhati**, a spokesperson for the **Samajwadi Party**, faced backlash after a video surfaced showing him making derogatory remarks against the Brahmin community.  **Pankaj Chaudhary**, the state BJP president and Union Minister, condemned the comments as "indecent" and said they reflected the SP's "divide and rule" mentality. Deputy Chief Minister **Brajesh Pathak** called the remarks "disgusting" and a reflection of the SP's character.  **Ajay Rai**, the state Congress chief, demanded disciplinary action against Bhati and an apology from **Akhilesh Yadavji**, the SP chief. A case was filed against Bhati under Section 196(1) of the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita for allegedly promoting enmity between groups on grounds of religion.

recent_articles.title: School education index: Kerala betters grade, score - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite the denial of funds by the **Union government**, **Kerala** has improved its performance in the **Union Ministry of Education’s Performance Grading Index 2.0 for States/Union Territories (UT) for the year 2024-25**. The state received a Prachesta-2 grade, an improvement from Prachesta-3 in 2023-24, with scores rising from 594.2 to 687.7.  **Kerala** achieved the topmost Utkarsh grade (72.8-80) in access and the Uttam-1 grade (81-90.9) in teacher education and training, among other achievements. The report highlights Kerala's progress despite challenges, including a lack of funding from the **Union government**.

recent_articles.title: Assam swearing-in LIVE: Himanta Biswa Sarma takes oath as Assam CM; Four MLAs sworn in as Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma** was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Assam for a second consecutive term on Tuesday, May 2, 2026. **Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya** administered the oath of office at a ceremony held at the Veterinary Ground in Guwahati.  Joining **Sarma** were four other MLAs who took oaths as Ministers: **Rameswar Teli**, **Ajanta Neog**, **Atul Bora**, and **Charan Boro**. The event was attended by prominent figures including **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, Sarbananda Sonowal, Pabitra Margherita**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin**. This marks the formation of a third successive NDA government in the state.

recent_articles.title: Siddaramaiah launches counter-attack, accuses Modi of destroying dignity of Prime Minister’s post - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister of Karnataka, criticized **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** for his recent speech in Bengaluru, accusing him of using "lies, poor taste, hatred and jealousy" to undermine the Prime Minister's office.  **Siddaramaiah** questioned the authenticity of the speech, suggesting it reflected poorly on **Modi**'s government and party in Karnataka.

recent_articles.title: ECI set to roll out phase III of SIR in ‘coming days’ to cover 22 States, UTs - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Election Commission of India (ECI)** is set to begin phase three of its Special Intensive Revision (SIR) voter list process in the coming days, covering nearly 40 crore electors across 17 states and five UTs.  This follows completion of SIR in 10 states and three UTs previously, which has successfully removed over 60 lakh deceased voters from the rolls. The ECI had initially delayed the rollout due to Assembly elections in several states but is now proceeding with the revision process.  The exercise aims to ensure accurate voter lists for upcoming elections.

recent_articles.title: Govt. to bring reforms in AYUSH sector to enhance quality: Health Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The State government of Andhra Pradesh** is implementing reforms in the AYUSH sector to enhance healthcare services and combat the distribution of fake drugs. **Minister for Health, Medical Education and Family Welfare Satya Kumar Yadav** announced the establishment of three committees – an expert committee, a stakeholders committee, and a technical committee – to develop new guidelines. The committees will consult experts, gather public feedback, and study best practices from other states like Kerala, Karnataka, and Tamil Nadu before submitting their recommendations.  The aim is to strengthen the regulatory framework for AYUSH clinics and hospitals, ensuring all practitioners are qualified and services meet national standards.

recent_articles.title: Telangana BJP distances itself from POCSO case against Bandi Sanjay’s son, calls it legal issue - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP) in Telangana distanced itself from a POCSO case involving the son of Union Minister of State for Home Affairs, Bandi Sanjay Kumar. The state BJP president, N. Ramchander Rao, stated that the party has no connection to the matter and will investigate if any family member is involved.  Rao also addressed allegations of discrepancies in the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) conducted during the recent Assembly elections, claiming it was a clean-up exercise approved by the Election Commission and Supreme Court. He asserted that the SIR aimed to eliminate "bogus" voters and that the results reflected the mandate of genuine voters.

recent_articles.title: In Kerala, nearly half of Congress’ MLAs-elect are young faces - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** emerged victorious in the recent Kerala Assembly elections, with a significant number of young leaders securing victory.  The party's new leadership, largely comprised of first-time legislators and youth activists, includes individuals like **O.J. Janeesh**, **Abin Varkey**, and **A.D. Thomas**. These newly elected representatives, who are significantly younger than the average age of senior Congress leaders in the state, attribute their success to factors such as organizational preparedness, a favorable political climate, and the public's dissatisfaction with the ruling Left Democratic Front (LDF) government. The party is optimistic about the future leadership of these young candidates, predicting they will guide the party for at least the next 15 years.

recent_articles.title: Telangana BJP chief’s special memento for Modi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **N. Ramachandra Rao**, the State BJP president, presented **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** with eight bronze Asthalaxmis at a public meeting in Hyderabad on Sunday.  Earlier, **Union Minister G.Kishan Reddy** honored **Modi** with a shawl and a statue of Lord Ram from Ayodhya during a separate event at the HICC.

recent_articles.title: Hantavirus outbreak: Cruise ship passengers start disembarking in Spain, all to be checked for symptoms - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Passengers** on the quarantined **MV Hondius** cruise ship began disembarking in Tenerife, Spain after an outbreak of hantavirus.  The **World Health Organization (WHO)** and Spanish authorities are overseeing the evacuation process, with more than 20 nationalities represented among the passengers and crew. **Oceanwide Expeditions**, the cruise operator, is working to disinfect the vessel before it sails to Rotterdam in the Netherlands for further procedures. The outbreak has resulted in three deaths and five confirmed cases of hantavirus infection, while authorities are investigating the source of the virus and its transmission on board.

recent_articles.title: NDA leaders stake claim to form Assam government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma**, leader of the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**-led **National Democratic Alliance (NDA)**, was unanimously elected as the leader of the Assam Legislature Party.  Following this, the NDA staked a claim to form the government in Assam with the support of 102 MLAs. The swearing-in ceremony for the new council of ministers is scheduled for May 12th. **J.P. Nadda**, Union Minister and central observer for the BJP Legislature Party meeting, announced that eight BJP legislators proposed Sarma's name as their leader.  The newly elected members of the BJP and its regional allies — **Asom Gana Parishad (AGP)** and **Bodoland People’s Front (BPF)** — chose their leaders in the morning.

recent_articles.title: Regional, caste calculus in BJP’s West Bengal Cabinet choices - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** appointed five ministers in West Bengal, including **Chief Minister Suvendu Adhikari**, to reflect regional and community considerations.  **Dilip Ghosh**, **Agnimitra Paul**, **Ashok Kirtania**, **Kshudiram Tudu**, and **Nisith Pramanik** were sworn in on Saturday (May 9, 2026), representing diverse regions and caste backgrounds. The appointments aim for a balanced representation within the state's legislature.  The BJP now holds a majority in the West Bengal Assembly after winning 207 seats.

recent_articles.title: Hantavirus may've spread to remote island - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **WHO** director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, along with **Spain** health minister Monica Garcia and interior minister Fernando Grande-Marlaska, are coordinating the disembarkation of the Dutch-flagged cruise ship MV Hondius after two suspected hantavirus cases emerged thousands of miles apart. The first case involved a man who fell ill after leaving the ship, while another occurred on a plane where a woman became sick near an infected passenger.  **WHO** officials are working to reassure residents that the risk remains low and passengers will be screened before disembarking.

recent_articles.title: West Bengal Cabinet 2026: From Dilip Ghosh to Agnimitra Paul, Ministers who were sworn in along with Suvendu Adhikari - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Suvendu Adhikari**, newly sworn in as the Chief Minister of West Bengal, inducted five new ministers into his cabinet on Saturday. The swearing-in ceremony was attended by **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, J. P. Nadda, and Dharmendra Pradhan**, among other BJP leaders.  **Dilip Ghosh**, a senior BJP leader who secured victory in the Kharagpur seat, **Agnimitra Paul**, a fashion designer-turned-legislator who won Asansol Dakshin, **Ashok Kirtania**, a BJP stalwart who gained victory in Bangaon Uttar, and **Kshudiram Tudu**, a former school teacher from Ranibandh (ST) constituency, were among the newly appointed ministers.  **Nisith Pramanik**, a key face of BJP from North Bengal, was also inducted into the cabinet.

recent_articles.title: Congress slams Modi Government over women’s safety citing NCRB data - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** party leaders, including **Mallikarjun Kharge**, criticized the **Narendra Modi Government** for its handling of women's safety and rising crime rates.  Kharge cited data from the National Crime Records Bureau (NCRB) showing a significant increase in crimes against women, children, Dalits, Adivasis, and cybercrime during the past decade. He accused the government of using "Beti Bachao" and "Nari Vandan" as mere slogans while failing to address these issues effectively. **Alka Lamba**, president of the All India Mahila Congress, echoed these concerns, alleging that the BJP was shielding perpetrators instead of ensuring justice for victims.

recent_articles.title: Thalassemia awareness walk organised on Necklace Road - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Health Minister C. Damodar Raja Narasimha** flagged off a two-kilometer awareness walk on Necklace Road to commemorate International Thalassemia Day. The event, organized by the **Thalassemia and Sickle Cell Society (TSCS)**, aimed to promote thalassemia prevention, early screening, and accessible healthcare support.  Dr. Chandrakant Agarwal, President of TSCS, emphasized the importance of timely screening, awareness, and genetic counselling for preventing thalassemia.

recent_articles.title: Census enumerators ID can be verified through QR code - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Lalit Jain**, Director of Census Operations (DCO), **Haryana**, has introduced QR code-enabled identity cards for enumerators to address concerns about authenticity.  Jain explained that residents can verify the legitimacy of enumerators by scanning the codes on their ID cards. The first phase of the digital census, which began on April 1, aims to cover over 30 lakh households across India. Residents are legally obligated to answer Census-related questions, and while there have been no cases of FIRs for non-response, local authorities will be involved in encouraging participation.  The second phase of the census, focusing on caste enumeration, is scheduled for February 2027.

recent_articles.title: Gurugram gated societies not letting in enumerators; FIRs recommended against enumerators obstructing Census work - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Haryana** administration has recommended an FIR against two government school staff for alleged negligence in Census-related work and obstruction of duties.  **Gurugram Municipal Corporation Joint Commissioner Punit Kumar** stated that enumerators have been denied entry into several highrise apartment buildings, prompting him to write to RWAs to ensure their access. **Registrar General of India Mritunjay Kumar Narayan** flagged off awareness vans across Delhi for the ongoing Census 2027 public outreach campaign.  The first phase of the Census began on April 1 and will conclude by September 30, involving around 30 lakh enumerators.

recent_articles.title: Nitish Kumar’s son Nishant Kumar may join Bihar cabinet on May 7 - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Nitish Kumar's** son, **Nishant Kumar**, is a subject of speculation regarding his potential inclusion in the new **Samrat Choudhary**-led NDA government cabinet.  Senior **JD(U)** leaders met with **Nitish Kumar** and held meetings in Patna ahead of the Cabinet expansion scheduled for Thursday. The event will be attended by Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**, Union Home Minister **Narendra Modi**, BJP president **Nitin Nabin**, and other senior NDA leaders, but no official confirmation has been made regarding **Nishant Kumar's** inclusion.  The administration is preparing for the ceremony at Gandhi Maidan with security personnel, police dogs, and waterproof tents to ensure a smooth event despite weather warnings of hailstorms and rain.

recent_articles.title: Bihar Cabinet expansion on May 7, Modi, Shah and Nabin to attend event - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin** will be present for the expansion of the **Bihar Cabinet** in Patna on Thursday, May 7, 2026.  The event is expected to feature most members from the previous Nitish Kumar-led NDA government retained, with a few new faces added to fill all 36 berths. The **BJP** aims for a "gala event" and preparations are underway at Gandhi Maidan. **Jitan Ram Manjhi**, leader of the HAM (S), has stated he will not demand a Cabinet berth and is content with whatever is offered.  The expansion is expected to include some new faces, potentially more women Ministers, and may see the return of several existing ministers from both the JD(U) and BJP.

recent_articles.title: BJP-led NDA scores hat-trick in Assam - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party** (BJP) secured a historic victory in the Assam Assembly elections, winning 102 of 126 seats to retain power for a third consecutive term. The BJP's regional allies, the **Asom Gana Parishad** (AGP) and the **Bodoland People’s Front** (BPF), also performed well, winning 10 and 10 seats respectively.  The Congress party suffered its worst performance since losing power in 2016, winning only 19 seats. Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma, who retained his Jalukbari seat, is now considered one of the BJP's most prominent leaders in Assam.

recent_articles.title: Tele-MANAS helpline counselling 3,000 people per month in A.P., says Health Minister - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** Minister for Health, Family Welfare and Medical Education Satya Kumar Yadav stated that the **Tele-MANAS** helpline, launched by the **Union government** in 2022 to address mental health issues, is providing support to individuals experiencing stress, depression, and anxiety. The national helpline, operated by **NIMHANS**, Bengaluru, routes calls to call centers within each state, with two centers in Andhra Pradesh located in Vijayawada and Visakhapatnam.

recent_articles.title: Rift widens within the Haryana BJP over its Rajya Sabha MP’s comments on former CM Bhajan Lal - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Kuldeep Bishnoi**, son of former Haryana Chief Minister Bhajan Lal, warned the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** against arrogance and disrespect toward senior leaders after **Rekha Sharma**, a Rajya Sabha MP, made remarks about Bhajan Lal.  Bishnoi, who joined the BJP from Congress in 2022, emphasized his contributions to the party's victories in Haryana and demanded respect for Bhajan Lal. He threatened further action if the party did not address the issue. Sharma later clarified her comments but the controversy has caused unease within the BJP.

recent_articles.title: BJD asks Odisha Speaker to disqualify MLAs who cross-voted in Rajya Sabha election - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Biju Janata Dal (BJD)** has demanded the disqualification of eight Odisha MLAs who voted against the party's decision in the March 16 Rajya Sabha election. The BJD, citing the Tenth Schedule, argues that these MLAs violated party directives and should be disqualified for defying the whip.  The MLAs, however, maintain their actions were constitutional and claim the move is an attempt to pressure them into submission. **Surama Padhy**, the Odisha Assembly Speaker, is currently examining the BJD's formal complaint.

recent_articles.title: World’s hottest cities: India transforms into a scorching furnace with cities shockingly hitting 46°C | World News - The Times of India
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **India's** heatwave continues to impact multiple cities, with temperatures reaching 46 degrees Celsius in several areas. **The India Meteorological Department (IMD)** has issued warnings about the intense heat, predicting a heatwave in parts of Jammu & Kashmir, Himachal Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana, Delhi, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh, Rajasthan, and central India. The IMD advises citizens to take precautions against heat stress by avoiding sun exposure during peak hours, staying hydrated, wearing loose-fitting clothing, and limiting strenuous activity.

recent_articles.title: Drug menace emerges as key plank in Amit Shah’s campaign for Punjab polls - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Amit Shah**, **Union home minister**, will be visiting **Punjab** next month to address the drug menace, a key part of the BJP's campaign strategy for the 2027 Assembly elections.  The party has signaled its intention to go it alone in the state after severing ties with the Shiromani Akali Dal (SAD) and bringing over seven Rajya Sabha MPs from the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP). **Shah** previously promised to eradicate drugs within two years, a goal he believes will help broaden the BJP's appeal beyond urban centers.

recent_articles.title: 10 of 26 petitioners caught in Russia-Ukraine crossfire dead; some volunteered, others duped, government tells Supreme Court - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union government** informed the Supreme Court that 10 of the 26 individuals who claimed to have been "human-trafficked" to fight in Ukraine are deceased.  **Additional Solicitor General Aishwarya Bhati** stated that the government is pursuing a multi-pronged strategy, including advising young people against traveling to Russia, while acknowledging cases of individuals being misled by agents. The court expressed concern over bringing back the remains from the conflict zone and requested a detailed status report.

recent_articles.title: Raghav Chadha and 6 AAP Rajya Sabha MPs join BJP in a major political shift - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Seven** members of the **Aam Aadmi Party (AAP)** in the Rajya Sabha have defected to the **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)**, a move that significantly alters the political landscape of the Upper House. The MPs, Raghav Chadha, Sandeep Pathak, and Ashok Kumar Mittal, met with **BJP president Nitin Nabin** at the party's headquarters on Friday evening.  The AAP has accused the BJP of orchestrating "Operation Lotus" to recruit its members.

recent_articles.title: AP Ministers continue Singapore training on governance, development models - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Andhra Pradesh** Ministers, led by **Municipal Administration and Urban Development Minister P. Narayana**, are participating in a four-day training program in Singapore focusing on governance, industrial growth, and sustainable development practices. The delegation is studying Singapore's approaches to economic development, technological advancement, and environmentally sustainable governance, with former **Singapore Prime Minister’s Office** minister **Lim Swee Say** delivering a session outlining the city-state's transformation.  The program, hosted by the **Singapore government** and the **World Bank**, aims to help the delegation adapt these models to Andhra Pradesh's administrative framework.

recent_articles.title: Can fish hook voters in India’s West Bengal elections? | Elections News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: In the upcoming West Bengal state election, **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) is employing a novel campaign tactic: using fish to connect with voters.  The party has sent candidates like Sharadwat Mukherjee campaigning door-to-door with Catla fish, highlighting the importance of fish in Bengali culture. This strategy comes amidst accusations from **Mamata Banerjee**, the incumbent chief minister, that the BJP would ban fish, meat, and eggs if elected, a claim the BJP denies.  The use of fish on the campaign trail is seen by some as a novelty and a way for both parties to create new images in voters' minds.

recent_articles.title: Govt claims women winning unreserved panchayat seats in ‘significant numbers’ - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Union Government** celebrated National Panchayati Raj Day, highlighting the progress of women's reservation in Panchayati Raj Institutions (PRIs).  While the Constitution mandates a 33% quota for women in urban and rural local bodies, 19 states have extended this provision to reserve 50% seats for women. However, data shows that the actual number of women representatives exceeds the prescribed quota in only 10 states/union territories, while four others fail to meet it.  The Ministry emphasized the increasing representation of women in PRIs, but acknowledged discrepancies between mandated and achieved quotas across various states.
